newsitem.title: USA: Analytical Surveys gets deals for $8.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Analytical Surveys gets deals for $8.6 mln.

text.p: Analytical Surveys Inc said on Monday that it has received four new contracts with a combined value of $8.6 million.
The company said the orders advance its backlog to an all-time high of $43 million.
The contracts include a $4.2 million order from Fairfax County, Virginia.

Analytical Surveys provides digital mapping and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) database services. The company specializes in converting paper based maps, aerial photography and other information formats into digital form.
